messages.content: Include exactly 5 numbers in the response. For a generative AI system, suppose a generated output is substantially similar to an item in the training dataset. Does this prove that the training dataset item was memorized?

message.content: No, substantial similarity does not prove memorization. A model can learn general patterns from training data without storing specific items verbatim. Consider a student who reads 5 books on a topic and writes an essay resembling 1 of them; this resemblance reflects learned general knowledge, not copying. The model may have internalized the statistical distribution and stylistic features rather than the exact token sequence. Proving true memorization would require demonstrating that the model reproduces rare, idiosyncratic details that no general pattern across 3 broad categories could account for, verified in 2 independent trials over 4 conditions.
